name: qodo
description: Qodo coding rules, local review, and pull request finding resolution for the Cursor agent. Community packaging of Qodo's open-source Agentic Toolbox. Not the retired Qodo IDE extension.

QODO_API_KEY.title: Qodo API key
QODO_API_KEY.description: Personal API key from the Qodo portal (app.qodo.ai). Sent as a Bearer token to the Qodo MCP server. Do not commit this value.

QODO_MCP_URL.title: Qodo MCP server URL
QODO_MCP_URL.description: Streamable HTTP endpoint, including the trailing slash. Leave the default for Qodo Cloud. Single-tenant and on-premises workspaces use the URL from the Qodo portal.
